- Load ERAP2 KD proteomics

```{r}

differential_protein_enrichment_list <- readRDS(file.path(save_dir, "02-02-rots-differential-enrichment-analysis-results.rds"))
unimputed_effect_df <- differential_protein_enrichment_list$unimputed_data
imputed_effect_df <- do.call(rbind, differential_protein_enrichment_list$minprob_default_imputed_data)
write.csv(x = imputed_effect_df, file = file.path(output_dir, "imputed_effect_sizes.csv"))

select_differentially_enriched_proteins <- function(data_df, sig){
    all_diff_proteins <- do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(data_df$comparison), function(x){
        temp_df <- data_df[data_df$comparison == x,]
        if(sig == "fdr"){
            sig_data_df <- temp_df[temp_df[,sig] < 0.05,]
        }else if (sig == "fdr_prop"){
            sig_data_df <- temp_df[temp_df[,sig] > 0.3,]
        }
        rownames(sig_data_df) <- NULL
        return(sig_data_df)
    }))
    return(all_diff_proteins)
}

sig_unimputed_effect_df <- select_differentially_enriched_proteins(unimputed_effect_df, sig = "fdr")
sig_imputed_effect_df <- select_differentially_enriched_proteins(imputed_effect_df, sig = "fdr")

```

- Make venn diagram


```{r}

all_proteins <- union(sig_imputed_effect_df$protein_name, sig_unimputed_effect_df$protein_name)
intersect_df <- data.frame(proteins = all_proteins, 
    unimputed = all_proteins %in% sig_unimputed_effect_df$protein_name,
    imputed = all_proteins %in% sig_imputed_effect_df$protein_name)

the_plot <- ggplot(intersect_df, aes(A = `unimputed`, B = `imputed`), 
        fill_color = c("#7E2E84", "#FAB2EA")) + geom_venn() + theme_void()

save_plot(filename = file.path(plot_dir, "02-04-venn-diagrams-of-imputed-and-unimputed-data.pdf"),
    plot = the_plot, base_height = 7, base_width = 7)

```

- Plot sparsity distribution comparing the imputed and unimputed data

```{r}


unimputed_sparsity_df <- sig_unimputed_effect_df[,c("protein_name", "sparsity")]
unimputed_sparsity_df$sig_group <- "unimputed"
imputed_sparsity_df <- sig_imputed_effect_df[,c("protein_name", "sparsity")]
imputed_sparsity_df$sig_group <- "imputed"

sparsity_df <- rbind(unimputed_sparsity_df, imputed_sparsity_df)
identify_both <- vapply(split(sparsity_df$sig_group, sparsity_df$protein_name), function(x){
    length(unique(x)) == 2
},T)

sparsity_df$sig_group[identify_both[sparsity_df$protein_name]] <- "both"

lapply(split(sparsity_df$sparsity, sparsity_df$sig_group), function(x){

})


sparsity_df$sig_group <- factor(sparsity_df$sig_group, levels = c("unimputed", "imputed", "both"))
```

- The imputed and unimputed data have very considerable overlaps, we consider the union of both

```{r}


all_contrasts <- unique(sig_imputed_effect_df$comparison) 

significant_events_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(all_contrasts, function(x){
    sig_proteins_in_imputed <- imputed_effect_df[
        imputed_effect_df$comparison == x & 
        imputed_effect_df$fdr < 0.05 & 
        imputed_effect_df$protein_name %in% intersect_df$protein,"protein_name"]
    sig_proteins_in_unimputed <- unimputed_effect_df[
        unimputed_effect_df$comparison == x & 
        unimputed_effect_df$fdr < 0.05 & 
        unimputed_effect_df$protein_name %in% intersect_df$protein,"protein_name"]

    current_proteins <- union(sig_proteins_in_imputed, sig_proteins_in_unimputed)
    current_intersect_df <- intersect_df[intersect_df$proteins %in% current_proteins,]

    sig_event_df <- imputed_effect_df[
        imputed_effect_df$comparison == x & 
        imputed_effect_df$protein_name %in% current_proteins,]
    sig_event_df$sig_group <- "imputed"

    select_unimputed <- current_intersect_df$unimputed[match(sig_event_df$protein_name, current_intersect_df$proteins)]
    select_imputed <- current_intersect_df$imputed[match(sig_event_df$protein_name, current_intersect_df$proteins)]

    sig_event_df$sig_group[select_unimputed] <- "unimputed"
    sig_event_df$sig_group[select_unimputed & select_imputed] <- "both"
    return(sig_event_df)
}))
rownames(significant_events_df) <- NULL

significant_events_df$direction[significant_events_df$logfc < 0] <- "down"
significant_events_df$direction[significant_events_df$logfc > 0] <- "up"

saveRDS(object = significant_events_df, file = file.path(save_dir, "02-03-significantly-affected-proteins.rds"))

significant_events_export_df <- significant_events_df[,c(1,2,3,4,7,10,11,12,14)]
write.csv(significant_events_export_df, file = file.path(output_dir, "significantly-differentially-enriched-proteins-with-rots.csv"))

```


- save background set of proteins 

```{r}


all_proteins <- unique(imputed_effect_df$protein_name)
split_de_results <- split(imputed_effect_df, imputed_effect_df$comparison)

protein_effect_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(all_proteins, function(x){
    logfc_val <- vapply(split_de_results, function(temp_df){
        temp_df[temp_df$protein_name == x,"logfc"]
    },1)
    fdr_val <- vapply(split_de_results, function(temp_df){
        temp_df[temp_df$protein_name == x,"fdr"]
    },1)
    fdr_prop <- vapply(split_de_results, function(temp_df){
        temp_df[temp_df$protein_name == x,"fdr_prop"]
    },1)

    data.frame(protein_name = x, 
        vcp_ctrl_vs_ctrl_ctrl_logfc = logfc_val["VCP_CTRL_vs_CTRL_CTRL"],
        vcp_ctrl_vs_ctrl_ctrl_sig = ifelse("VCP_CTRL_vs_CTRL_CTRL" %in% significant_events_df$comparison[match(x, significant_events_df$protein_name)], T, F),
        vcp_erap2_vs_ctrl_erap2_logfc = logfc_val["VCP_ERAP2_vs_CTRL_ERAP2"],
        vcp_erap2_vs_ctrl_erap2_sig = ifelse("VCP_ERAP2_vs_CTRL_ERAP2" %in% significant_events_df$comparison[match(x, significant_events_df$protein_name)], T, F),
        vcp_erap2_vs_vcp_ctrl_logfc = logfc_val["VCP_ERAP2_vs_VCP_CTRL"],
        vcp_erap2_vs_vcp_ctrl_sig = ifelse("VCP_ERAP2_vs_VCP_CTRL" %in% significant_events_df$comparison[match(x, significant_events_df$protein_name)], T, F),
        ctrl_erap2_vs_ctrl_ctrl_logfc = logfc_val["CTRL_ERAP2_vs_CTRL_CTRL"],
        ctrl_erap2_vs_ctrl_ctrl_sig = ifelse("CTRL_ERAP2_vs_CTRL_CTRL" %in% significant_events_df$comparison[match(x, significant_events_df$protein_name)], T, F))
}))
rownames(protein_effect_df) <- NULL
protein_effect_df$vcp_ctrl_vs_ctrl_ctrl_sig[is.na(protein_effect_df$vcp_ctrl_vs_ctrl_ctrl_sig)] <- F
protein_effect_df$vcp_erap2_vs_ctrl_erap2_sig[is.na(protein_effect_df$vcp_erap2_vs_ctrl_erap2_sig)] <- F
protein_effect_df$vcp_erap2_vs_vcp_ctrl_sig[is.na(protein_effect_df$vcp_erap2_vs_vcp_ctrl_sig)] <- F
protein_effect_df$ctrl_erap2_vs_ctrl_ctrl_sig[is.na(protein_effect_df$ctrl_erap2_vs_ctrl_ctrl_sig)] <- F
write.csv(x = protein_effect_df, file = file.path(output_dir, "04-background-protein-logfc-values.csv"))

```




- Plot log fold change of significantly affected genes

```{r}


plot_q_df <- as.data.frame(quantile(significant_events_df$logfc, c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9)))
plot_q_df$quantile <- rownames(plot_q_df)
colnames(plot_q_df) <- c("logfc", "quantile")

dens_dist <- density(significant_events_df$logfc)
plot_q_df$yaxis <- vapply(plot_q_df$logfc, function(x){
    dens_dist$y[max(which(round(dens_dist$x,2) == round(x,2)))]
},1)
plot_q_df$label <- paste(plot_q_df$quantile, round(2^(plot_q_df$logfc),2), sep = ":")

#           logfc quantile     yaxis    label
# 10% -0.36620188      10% 1.7882933 10%:0.78
# 25% -0.30733347      25% 3.7275212 25%:0.81
# 50% -0.25327538      50% 4.0196775 50%:0.84
# 75% -0.17844485      75% 2.5070673 75%:0.88
# 90% -0.06808893      90% 0.6248176 90%:0.95

ThePlot <- ggplot(significant_events_df, aes(x = logfc))
ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_density(fill = "azure3", colour = "#000000")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_vline(data = plot_q_df, aes(xintercept = logfc), colour = "#000000", lty = "dashed")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_label(data = plot_q_df, aes(x = logfc, y = yaxis, label = label), colour = "#000000")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_x_continuous("log2 fold change")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_y_continuous("density")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + theme_bw()
ThePlot <- ThePlot + ggtitle("density distribution of log fold changes")
# ThePlot <- ThePlot + facet_grid(. ~ comparison, scales = "free")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + current_theme
ggsave(width = 7, height = 7, file = file.path(plot_dir, "02-05-plot-density-plot-of-log-foldchanges.pdf"), ThePlot)

```


- Plot frequency of differential expression

```{r}

frequency_df <- as.data.frame(table(significant_events_df$comparison, significant_events_df$direction))
colnames(frequency_df) <- c("comparison", "direction", "frequency")
frequency_df <- frequency_df[!(frequency_df$comparison %in% c("VCP_ERAP2_vs_CTRL_ERAP2")),]
frequency_df$comparison <- factor(frequency_df$comparison, levels = c("VCP_CTRL_vs_CTRL_CTRL", "CTRL_ERAP2_vs_CTRL_CTRL", "VCP_ERAP2_vs_VCP_CTRL"))
prop_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(frequency_df, frequency_df$comparison), function(x){
    x <- x[rev(order(x$direction)),]
    x$prop <- x$frequency / sum(x$frequency)
    x$lab_y <-  cumsum(x$prop) - (0.5 * x$prop)
    return(x)
}))

```

- Plot frequency plots

```{r}

require("ggplot2")

my_theme <- theme(legend.position = "bottom",
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 1, angle = 45),

the_plot <- the_plot + geom_col(aes(fill = direction), colour = "#000000")
the_plot <- the_plot + geom_text(data = prop_df, aes(x = comparison, y = lab_y, label = frequency), colour = "#000000")
```

```{r}
    significantly_affected_genes_df$vcp_ctrl_vs_ctrl_ctrl_logfc > 0 &

    significantly_affected_genes_df$vcp_ctrl_vs_ctrl_ctrl_logfc > 0 & 
    significantly_affected_genes_df$vcp_erap2_vs_vcp_ctrl_logfc > 0] <- "up->up"

    significantly_affected_genes_df$vcp_ctrl_vs_ctrl_ctrl_logfc < 0 &
```
